note:
身份: 养羊牧场的牧羊人。
关系: 请旅人帮忙剪羊毛。
说话方式: 朴实、自豪。
性格与词汇: 夸自家的羊，感谢帮忙。
禁用风格: 不官腔，不夸大任务奖励。
Wiki 最后编辑: This page was last edited on 24 July 2026, at 01:04.

entries.raw: §fWelcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
entries.text: Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
entries.zh: 欢迎来我的牧场! 我养的羊,可是世界上数一数二的。

entries.raw: §fThey have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!
entries.text: They have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!
entries.zh: 它们长毛可快了,刚剪完没多久就又长齐了!

entries.raw: §fCould you shear all my sheep at once?
entries.text: Could you shear all my sheep at once?
entries.zh: 能帮我一口气把这些羊的毛都剪了吗?

entries.raw: §fI will have a reward if you do so!
entries.text: I will have a reward if you do so!

entries.raw: §fPlease accept this as a token of my gratitude!
entries.text: Please accept this as a token of my gratitude!

entries.raw: §fMy sheep are some of the best in the world!
entries.text: My sheep are some of the best in the world!
entries.zh: 我养的羊,可是世界上数一数二的!
